parsed.name: 实时绘图客户端
parsed.description: 用于实验室测量过程中的实时数据可视化客户端，可显示一维曲线、XY 曲线和二维伪彩图/热图，并支持追加数据、清空、隐藏、移除和文本标注等操作，便于在线监测实验信号与扫描结果。
parsed.description_en: A real-time data visualization client for laboratory measurements. It displays 1D traces, XY curves, and 2D pseudocolor/heatmap data, and supports appending data, clearing, hiding, removing, and adding text labels for live monitoring of signals and scan results.

actions.description: 向绘图器发送数据和元数据。
